claude.performance_metric: Chapter 11 filed May 15, 2023 (~$7.7bn debt); ~$5.6bn debt equitized/cancelled; KKR's ~$5bn+ 2018 equity wiped out
claude.rationale: The slice documents a financial/leverage-driven Chapter 11 with contributing factors cited as ~$7.7bn debt, declining patient volumes, the federal No Surprises Act, and disputes with health insurers — external market and regulatory pressures rather than a documented product/process operating-alignment breakdown, so p4 cannot be affirmatively coded (uncertain). No evidence in the slice describes an operations-versus-people/management/culture fracture; the leadership changes noted (interim CEO, new board head) occur at emergence as part of restructuring, not as a documented process/organization integration failure, so p5 is coded 0. The restructuring split off the Amsurg ambulatory-surgery unit into separate ownership, but this is a reorganization step, not documented product/process or process/org disruption.
